why: The answer depends on the definition of biomagnification — the rising concentration of a non-degradable toxicant at successive trophic levels — which no chapter in the supplied list teaches.
note: TAXONOMY GAP: I expected 'Environmental Issues' (NCERT XII Ch.16), where biomagnification of DDT and mercury is taught alongside water pollution; it is absent from the 32-chapter list. 'Ecosystem' is the nearest neighbour because it teaches trophic levels, but it teaches energy and biomass pyramids, not toxicant accumulation, so filing it there would be quietly wrong.
